# Twinkle Brothers

Twinkle Brothers are a reggae band founded in 1962 in Falmouth, Jamaica, led by Norman Grant. Known for their distinctive sound, socially conscious lyrics, and decades-long collaboration with Polish highland folk band Trebunie-Tutki, they remain internationally active with an extensive discography and touring history.

- History: https://twinklebrothersmusic.com/history
- Discography: https://twinklebrothersmusic.com/discography
- Listen: https://twinklebrothersmusic.com/listen
- Tour: https://twinklebrothersmusic.com/tour
